URL: https://www.itv.com/news/2026-07-22/andy-burnham-unveils-2-bus-fare-cap-in-pledge-to-be-cost-of-living-government
NOTE: ITV News (22 Jul, 05:58) — Single bus fares in England capped at £2 from January. Current nationwide cap £3 until end March 2027. Backed by £454m funding; ~£400m from switching international climate finance investment to loans, rest from DESNZ savings. Total scheme cost >£500m, remainder from existing DfT bus funding. £2 cap in place Jan 2023–Dec 2024, then Labour argued unaffordable. Burnham: "Good, affordable transport links are essential. No one should be priced out of those and left behind. But for too long people have said that cheaper transport isn't an option. I don't accept that. I've done it before and I will do it again now: A £2 cap on bus fares for millions across the country. Lower fares will help people get to where they need to – giving them breathing space to help with the cost of living."
